title: Add AGENTS.md for Cursor Cloud development environment setup
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development instructions for future cloud agents. ### What's included - Service overview (Next.js dev server + hosted Supabase) - Environment variable documentation - Common commands reference (pointing to `CLAUDE.md` and `package.json`) - Gotchas discovered during setup (auth redirects, pre-existing lint errors, `.env.local` handling) ### Environment Setup Verified | Check | Result | |---|---| | `npm install` | Passes (391 packages) | | `npm run lint` | Pre-existing errors in utility scripts only | | `npm run build` | Passes cleanly (Next.js 16.2.2, Turbopack) | | `npm run dev` | Server starts on port 3000 | | Auth flow | Signup + login working via Supabase | | League creation | Full end-to-end league creation flow verified | | Player data | 609 players loaded from Supabase | ### Demo [fantasy_futbol_full_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-91682924-3233-4f31-9ba7-b35e2dc48ce9/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Ffantasy_futbol_full_demo.mp4) App running with signup, league creation, player browsing, and team formation all working. [Dashboard after signup](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-91682924-3233-4f31-9ba7-b35e2dc48ce9/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fdashboard_after_signup.webp) [League homepage](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-91682924-3233-4f31-9ba7-b35e2dc48ce9/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fleague_homepage.webp) [Player stats page](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-91682924-3233-4f31-9ba7-b35e2dc48ce9/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fplayer_stats.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
